text_block_list.text:
On the way home from going out with Nice 
Nature—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh, an incoming call.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Mom?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. I'm stepping out for a 
bit!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hello? What's up all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah... Well... so-so, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I'm fine. Don't worry, I've got this 
handled!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh!? You're coming over? When is 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez, you're always so sudden. Got 
it... Hit me up again later, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew, sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's still a ways off, though. Her 
friends invited her on a trip, apparently.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds like she'll be staying for a 
decent while, so I plan to go see her once 
she arrives."
choice_data_list:
Since you're here, why not show them how 
you run?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold up. Are you being for 
real?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, yeah? ...It's not like I don't 
want you to watch me or anything.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Having an open classroom visit at this 
age... Wait, isn't that super 
embarrassing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: R-Really?
choice_data_list: If I were your parent, I'd be overjoyed!

If I were the parent, I'd be absolutely 
thrilled!

text_block_list.text:
"Taking the time to travel all the way out 
here is all because they want to see how 
much Nice Nature has grown."
When I tell her that—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Trainer, aren't you sounding like a 
real guardian right now?
choice_data_list:
Well, I am your dedicated Trainer, after 
all.
After all, I'm your personal trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, that's true, but... do you 
really, honestly think that?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm... about earlier. About whether Mom 
would be happy or not.
choice_data_list:
Because I'm Nature's number one fan, 
aren't I?

Because I'm Nature's number one fan, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Even with mediocre results, 
they've always cheered me on—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, Nature-san loses! ...I'll call 
you that, alright?

I told her that as a Trainer, I wanted 
people to know more about just how 
wonderful my trainee is, and—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pupil? Who do you think you are, my 
teacher?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you are my Trainer, so you're kinda 
like a teacher, but still..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, do you really have a plan to make 
someone like me look good out there?
choice_data_list:
Your training's been paying off, so you'll 
be just fine!

text_block_list.text:
When I puffed out my chest and vouched for 
her, Nice Nature seemed a little relieved.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you're speaking with that much 
confidence, I take it you must have a 
secret plan or something?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Take responsibility and guide me properly, 
okay, 'T-e-a-c-h-e-r'?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello, Mom? It's about when you come 
over here."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you've got nothing to do and end up 
bored... ...wanna come check out Tracen 
Academy?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, you really don't have to push yourself 
to come! Just watching me run might be 
boring anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Really? ...Got it, I'll pass that 
along to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They said they'll come. They said they're 
looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Guess I gotta make sure I don't 
look uncool out there.

Nice Nature spoke with a weary 'good 
grief' tone, but her voice sounded 
bouncier than usual.
